newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Putra Surya says 1996 net positive.
newsitem.headline: Putra Surya says 1996 net positive.

text.p: Indonesian property firm PT Putra Surya Perkasa said on Friday its 1996 net profit was the most satisfying compared with other years.

"We have already got the unaudited 1996 results, but we cannot reveal it to you now. All that we can tell you is that the results are likely to be among the most satisfying compared with other years," director Rudy Soraya told reporters.
"We will let you know later this month when the auditing process has been completed," he said.
Soraya said the firm's sales of some of its apartment units were good, but declined to give further details.
Putra Surya posted a net profit of 56.28 billion rupiah in 1995.
